_comment: Each outlet: rating_note documents which watchdogs rated it Center/least-biased and High/Very-High factuality (see the project proposal for full sourcing/links). feeds maps beat -> RSS URL. verified: 'live' means this session fetched it directly and got real, current articles. 'assumed' means the URL is well-documented publicly but could not be reached from this session's sandboxed network (blocked by the target site's bot protection, not a sign the feed is dead) -- confirm on the first real GitHub Action run and fix here if a URL has moved.

outlets.name: BBC News
outlets.rating_note: Center (AllSides, Ad Fontes); publicly funded, not ad-driven

outlets.name: Deutsche Welle
outlets.rating_note: Least Biased / Center (MBFC); publicly funded, international desk

outlets.name: Wall Street Journal (news desk)
outlets.rating_note: Center on news pages specifically (AllSides) -- opinion section excluded

outlets.name: Financial Times (news desk)
outlets.rating_note: Center on news pages (AllSides); strong factuality

outlets.name: Christian Science Monitor
outlets.rating_note: Center at AllSides' highest confidence tier; Least Biased / High factual (MBFC). Funded by the Church of Christ, Scientist, which does not set editorial content on general news.

outlets.name: The Economist
outlets.rating_note: Least Biased (MBFC); near-center, good reliability (Ad Fontes: -3.09 bias / 41.41 reliability). AllSides alone rates it Lean Left at their lowest ('Medium') confidence tier. House style is unsigned analytical writing, not wire-style straight reporting.

manual_links.name: Reuters
manual_links.reason: No free public RSS (discontinued industry-wide years ago) -- check directly instead of automated pull.

manual_links.name: Associated Press (AP)
manual_links.reason: No official public RSS -- check directly instead of automated pull. Also the industry's authoritative source for down-ballot election results (AP Race Call).

manual_links.name: AFP
manual_links.reason: No genuine public news-wire RSS found (only a corporate press-release feed) -- check directly instead of automated pull.
